element_types.label: Component
element_types.description: A logical unit with one bounded runtime responsibility.

element_types.label: Transactional Store
element_types.description: A durable state owner with explicit transaction and concurrency semantics.

element_types.label: Concern-Specific Dependency Contract
element_types.description: A responsibility-specific consumer-owned seam; DomainSpec defines no universal code-level Port abstraction.

element_types.label: Infrastructure Binding
element_types.description: Metadata that connects a logical concern and dependency contract to an exact realization, guarantee, profile, and evidence boundary.

element_types.label: Adapter
element_types.description: A replaceable technology or external-system realization of a port.

element_types.label: Worker
element_types.description: A replaceable process that advances eligible dispatches under fenced authority.

element_types.label: Architecture Test
element_types.description: Executable evidence for one bounded architecture property.
